moments.text: Grainy black-and-white view down onto rugged terrain, overlaid with a numbered pitch ladder, a circle reticle and black redaction boxes.
The overlay changes to a long vertical line, then to stacked numbered rungs that climb as the view sweeps over blurred, hazy ground.
Two small dark spots appear right of centre, below the top redaction bar, and streak down-left past the ladder. 5 frames (~0.15 s): frame step.
A long dark diagonal streak enters at the top, right of centre, and sweeps down to the lower left, gone by 17.1 s.
The footage restarts from about 12 s and steps through frame by frame.
Frame-by-frame, the two dark spots enter right of the top rung and step down-left across the tilted ladder toward its left end.
The footage restarts again from about 12 s at slower speed.
Much larger black boxes cover most of the view while the slow replay zooms in on the centre of the ladder.
Zoomed in, the two dark spots show as blurry blobs drifting down-left from the upper right toward the diamond marker on the ladder.
The video holds on one enlarged frame: two dark blobs, one upper right and one left of centre, above the diamond marker and ladder rungs.
The picture breaks into noise and turns flat grey as the clip ends.

notes: First frame carries a video-player 'Tracking' progress bar overlay.
